_comment: JOB 5: per-target TEST environments. TEST-ONLY credentials - never the real password. Set password here or via ASTRA_TESTENV_ASTRA_BRIDGE_PASSWORD in .env. avd_name: set to your Android Studio AVD name (run 'emulator -list-avds') to let preflight auto-start it headless.

astra-backend._comment: Self-build target. When checkout runs for a sandbox clone, run_shell routes INTO the VM, so these localhost URLs resolve to the clone's services - not the live host.
